profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a public company traded under the ticker EFX and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, according to its profile record, which also lists the SEC filing identifier CIK 0000033185. Its website describes it as a credit bureau that provides credit reports and credit scores for businesses and consumers, along with identity protection tools offering daily monitoring and alerts.

The site presents a consumer-facing set of services and educational material. It names Equifax Complete as a monitoring product and describes dedicated ID Restoration Specialists who work on behalf of customers who become victims of identity theft. Much of the remaining content covers credit reports, credit scores, debt, credit cards, loans, fraud warning signs, and personal finance, with a Spanish-language section on Equifax credit reports, credit scores, and money management. The site does not describe any artificial intelligence products, and no products are listed in the company's tracked product record.

The held facts record no lawsuits and no MCP servers associated with the company. Its law exposure is recorded in Georgia, with a count of 105.
